recommended_first_method.name: conservative_piecewise_linear_inverse_mapping
recommended_first_method.description: Use piecewise linear inverse lookup over valid monotonic measured segments, with risk filtering and no extrapolation by default.
recommended_first_method.scope: offline dry-run design for Booster K1 only until physical validation

rejected_methods_for_now.name: global_nearest_neighbor_only
rejected_methods_for_now.reason: too coarse as the primary method, though useful as an audit fallback

rejected_methods_for_now.name: global_linear_interpolation_without_segments
rejected_methods_for_now.reason: unsafe when response is non-monotonic or crosses risky cells

rejected_methods_for_now.name: pchip_like_interpolation
rejected_methods_for_now.reason: defer until monotonicity and overshoot risks are controlled

rejected_methods_for_now.name: learned_regression_or_neural_model
rejected_methods_for_now.reason: defer due to small dataset size, auditability concerns, and missing physical validation

risk_controls: require platform and surface calibration before lookup
filter deadzone cells before inverse interpolation
avoid unstable and drift_prone cells by default
include yaw drift in feasibility decisions
return refusal statuses instead of forcing a command
